abstract: The following symposium on the production and significance of the present-day newsreel was one of the discussions in the series of popular subjects arranged by the Atlantic Coast Section of the Society to promote a wider knowledge of motion picture industry techniques and practices. Newsreel operation in peace and war and a résumé of the details of production are described by staff members of Movietone News.
